response_envelope.disposition_rationale: The hard constraints explicitly forbid wavelength substitution and require the light source to be between 410 and 430 nm. The only available light source in the inventory is 525 nm. Since 525 nm is outside the required 410-430 nm window and no other light sources are available, the experiment cannot be performed as specified. The photochemical excitation of the substrate/catalyst system is validated for 410-430 nm; using 525 nm would likely result in zero conversion or unknown side reactions, violating the objective to use the validated excitation window.
